units: ratios to W_in (= S) = clear span between the posts' inner faces, the camera of record unit. Metres = ratio x S_m (metres per W_in, see S_m_*).

S_m_assumed.status: ASSUMED placeholder until physics.json/camera.json give a metre gauge
S_m_assumed.note: build.py reads the gauge in this order: physics.json S_m | scene_unit_S_m, camera.json scale.S_m, then this value

world: config/coordinates.md: origin A = top-loop bearing point on the bar top (y = 0 through the bar centre), X along the bar to image right, Y away from the camera, Z up

post_width_x.method: box-model fit with the camera of record FIXED (params/camera.json load_camera(frame=0); scene/measure/fit_fixedcam.py), 1-sigma from the fit covariance

post_depth_y.method: box-model fit with the camera of record FIXED (params/camera.json load_camera(frame=0); scene/measure/fit_fixedcam.py), 1-sigma from the fit covariance; weakly observed (inner faces 10-14 px wide); prior d_p = w_p +- 0.05

post_top_z.method: box-model fit with the camera of record FIXED (params/camera.json load_camera(frame=0); scene/measure/fit_fixedcam.py), 1-sigma from the fit covariance; above A (bar top)

base_top_z.method: box-model fit with the camera of record FIXED (params/camera.json load_camera(frame=0); scene/measure/fit_fixedcam.py), 1-sigma from the fit covariance; base-plate top below A

frame_centre_x.method: box-model fit with the camera of record FIXED (params/camera.json load_camera(frame=0); scene/measure/fit_fixedcam.py), 1-sigma from the fit covariance; frame centre relative to A (A under the top loop)

bar_height_z.method: box-model fit with the camera of record FIXED (params/camera.json load_camera(frame=0); scene/measure/fit_fixedcam.py), 1-sigma from the fit covariance

bar_depth_y.method: not visible from the front: 0.5 x bar height (flat bar)

plate_width_x.method: box-model fit with the camera of record FIXED (params/camera.json load_camera(frame=0); scene/measure/fit_fixedcam.py), 1-sigma from the fit covariance; front-corner silhouettes (2 px residual from the plan-view corner rounding)

plate_depth_y.method: box-model fit with the camera of record FIXED (params/camera.json load_camera(frame=0); scene/measure/fit_fixedcam.py), 1-sigma from the fit covariance

plate_centre_y.method: box-model fit with the camera of record FIXED (params/camera.json load_camera(frame=0); scene/measure/fit_fixedcam.py), 1-sigma from the fit covariance; prior 0 +- 0.05

plate_thickness.method: box-model fit with the camera of record FIXED (params/camera.json load_camera(frame=0); scene/measure/fit_fixedcam.py), 1-sigma from the fit covariance

table_back_edge_y.method: box-model fit with the camera of record FIXED (params/camera.json load_camera(frame=0); scene/measure/fit_fixedcam.py), 1-sigma from the fit covariance; table/backdrop crease row 827-830 px

plate_corner_radius.method: front-left/right plan-view corner rounding read on 2x zooms (~22 px)

plate_top_edge_radius.method: highlight band on the plate's front top edge (~4 px)

screw_head_radius.method: front screw heads (u 510 / 1399, v 1042-1045), ~26 px wide

screw_inset_x.method: screw centre to plate side edge (~33 px)

screw_inset_y.method: screw centre to plate front edge, from v 1042 between the front (1056) and back (984) top edges

hook_wire_radius.method: VR-08 (visual review ck001): S-hook shank 14-15 px wide at f0 rows v 140-150 (render was 9 px with the v001 eye reading of 8 px); 673 px/W_in at the spring plane, frame 0

spring_wire_radius.method: coil wire width on zooms (6.5 px)

coil_mean_radius.method: outer coil width f120/f240 (78-80 px) minus one wire, /2

top_loop_inner_height.method: outer loop height through the camera (v 47 -> 122 px) minus 2 wire diameters; must enclose the bar (h_b)

top_loop_inner_width_y.method: loop seen edge-on: bar depth (assumed) + clearance

loop_gap_A_px.method: the reference draws the loop's inner top ~6 px ABOVE the bar top edge (floating); the rig rests it on the bar (A = bar top)

hinge_P_eff_x.method: camera.json key_points.P_eff_world_on_plane_Y0 (LSQ intersection of 241 spring-axis lines)

hook_turns.method: lead decision (CHANGELOG): 2 static turns at the hook above the hinge

hook_turn_pitch.method: close turns (1.05 wire diameters); coil top is 0.012 W_in above P in the tracks

coil_count_open.method: measurement/spring_track.csv n_open_gaps median 11 (open pitch 29.1 px median)

coil_count_tight.method: counted on a 4x zoom of f240 (10-11 turns, pitch ~11 px vs wire ~6.5 px)

coil_body_open_length_ref.method: P -> tight-section start along P->H, mean over 241 frames (scene/measure/spring_layout.py)

coil_body_tight_length_ref.method: tight section length, mean over 241 frames

bottom_hardware_length.method: last coil -> H along the axis, mean over 241 frames

spring_length_ref_PH.method: |P_eff - H| mean over 241 frames (reference configuration of the section lengths)

bend_length.method: rotation ramps in over 0.3 open turns below P (bending concentrated at the top coil)

lower_loop_inner_width_y.method: loop seen nearly edge-on (16 px visible); width across the eye wire assumed 0.02 S larger

eye_wire_radius.method: eye ring band width: 12 px (VR-08 review; v001 read 10 px); outer diameter kept at the measured 65-67 px

eye_ring_radius.method: eye outer diameter (65-67 px) minus one wire, /2 (centreline)

weight_radius.method: measurement/weight_track.csv width_px median over 241 frames / per-frame px per W_in (v001 eye reading 0.1144 was 5 % high)

weight_height.method: silhouette length (median 0.3064 W_in, includes the top-face ellipse) minus D sin(view elevation 12.6 deg)

lower_loop_inner_length.method: outer loop length 80-82 px minus 2 wire diameters (loop top merges into the last coil)

derived.H_to_cylinder_centre_note: H = eye inner top; eye centre = H - (R_e - r_e); eye outer bottom touches the cylinder top: top = H - 2 R_e; centre = top - h/2

camera_frame0_approx.status: APPROXIMATE scene-role camera (frame 0 only, static); replaced by params/camera.json when it exists
